scope: Character foundations and progression; not a live balance certification

cards.name: Character creation and starting identity
cards.purpose: create a character with a starting allocation, then place that character into the shard's customized world/origin structure.
cards.reportHeading: ### PROG-01 — Character creation and starting identity

cards.name: Total training budgets and origin tradeoffs
cards.purpose: choose how broadly one character can develop.
cards.reportHeading: ### PROG-02 — Total training budgets and origin tradeoffs

cards.name: Base skill, effective skill and the real ceilings
cards.purpose: distinguish learned capability from temporary or equipped capability.
cards.reportHeading: ### PROG-03 — Base skill, effective skill and the real ceilings

cards.name: Learning skills through use
cards.purpose: turn suitable actions into chances for permanent base-skill growth.

cards.name: NPC teaching and training fixtures
cards.purpose: purchase or practice an early foundation before difficult play.
cards.reportHeading: ### PROG-05 — NPC teaching and training fixtures

cards.name: Raw stats, usable stats and vitals
cards.purpose: train the attributes that feed survivability, physical ability and magic resources.
cards.reportHeading: ### PROG-06 — Raw stats, usable stats and vitals

cards.name: Offline study
cards.purpose: trade book access and time away from play for chances to gain a selected skill.

cards.name: Power scrolls: greater ceiling, no immediate points
cards.purpose: turn rare rewards into permission to train beyond 100.
cards.reportHeading: ### PROG-08 — Power scrolls: greater ceiling, no immediate points

cards.name: Alacrity and Transcendence: speed versus direct points
cards.purpose: Accelerate selected skill gains or consume a scroll for direct base-skill points.
cards.reportHeading: ### PROG-09 — Alacrity and Transcendence: speed versus direct points

cards.name: Elixirs: temporary power linked to cooking and tasting
cards.purpose: temporarily raise effective skills rather than permanently training them.
cards.reportHeading: ### PROG-10 — Elixirs: temporary power linked to cooking and tasting

cards.name: Soulstones: move prior training
cards.purpose: preserve or transfer previously earned base skill so a character/account can change roles.

cards.name: Titan of Ether: a major permanent breadth reward
cards.purpose: convert a multi-part discovery/combat quest into more build space.
cards.reportHeading: ### PROG-12 — Titan of Ether: a major permanent breadth reward

cards.name: Character level: an estimate with real consumers
cards.purpose: summarize development for encounters and diagnostics. This service has no XP balance, spendable level points, training cost or saved level-up counter.
cards.reportHeading: ### PROG-13 — Character level: an estimate with real consumers

cards.name: Creature races: identity plus scaling bonuses
cards.purpose: play a creature identity with its own appearance, family, alignment, starting area, food rules and bonuses.
cards.reportHeading: ### PROG-14 — Creature races: identity plus scaling bonuses

cards.name: Fame and karma: progression, alignment and prices
cards.purpose: remember reputation and moral direction, with real mechanical consequences.
cards.reportHeading: ### PROG-15 — Fame and karma: progression, alignment and prices

cards.name: Rune quest and the two meanings of virtue
cards.purpose: reward collecting eight quest runes with reputation, identity resolution and a growing talisman.
cards.reportHeading: ### PROG-16 — Rune quest and the two meanings of virtue

cards.name: Death, resurrection, protection and permanent loss
cards.purpose: impose recovery cost and risk after defeat. The permanent loss is attached to particular resurrection paths, not a blanket mutation in `PlayerMobile.OnDeath`.
cards.reportHeading: ### PROG-17 — Death, resurrection, protection and permanent loss

cards.name: Side channels into permanent progression
cards.purpose: Identify peripheral routes that award or modify permanent progression outside the common training path.
